guide.title: Flash Fedora to an SD card.
guide.lead: Five steps with balenaEtcher. Works on Linux, macOS and Windows.
needItems: An SD card, 8 GB or larger
A computer with an SD card reader
beforeItems: Everything on the SD card will be erased
Do not remove the card while flashing
Check the MD5 checksum when one is listed

steps.title: Download a Fedora image
steps.text: Pick your board on this site and download the latest Fedora image. GNOME, KDE Plasma and Xfce builds are available depending on the board.

steps.title: Get balenaEtcher
steps.text: Download and install {etcher}, a cross-platform tool for flashing OS images to SD cards and USB drives.

steps.title: Select the image file
steps.text: Open balenaEtcher, click “Flash from file” and choose the Fedora image you downloaded.

steps.title: Choose the SD card
steps.text: Insert your SD card and click “Select target” to choose it as the destination device.

steps.title: Flash the image
steps.text: Click “Flash” to start writing the image to the SD card. This takes several minutes.
